dedupe_keys.name: pygreta renewable potential and time series

description: pyGRETA is the Technical University of Munich energy-systems team's Python tool for renewable-generation maps and time series. It models onshore and offshore wind, photovoltaics and concentrating solar power from MERRA-2 weather and user-defined technology assumptions. Inputs include a region shapefile and land-use, terrain or exclusion information; outputs include potential maps, generation series and area, capacity or energy summaries. Coverage is user-defined worldwide, with dates and time resolution determined by the chosen weather data. Source is free under GPL-3.0. A limitation is that exclusion rules, weather outliers and technology choices affect estimated potential; matching historical full-load hours does not independently validate every site. The tool prepares renewable inputs for electricity-infrastructure simulations. PyPSA (model-pypsa) is a related planning model. The README's Australian 2015 maps illustrate a configuration, not the package's full geographic coverage.
